name: generated-type-reference
description: A typed generated-view slot (RFC-040 Change J / #274 ratified ledger): identifies a metamodel Type by stable identity+version and a presentation profile. `content` is a generated projection — a property table (columns: property, type/cardinality, required, constraints/domain, extension owner, contextual description), an optional compact pseudo-IDL appendix, and a link to the raw JSON Schema — never hand-authored. Regenerated by scripts/gen-type-reference-tables.mjs from the resolved effective Type; never edited directly except to retarget referencedTypeId/referencedTypeVersion/presentationProfile. Narrative belongs in the surrounding subsection records, not here.
